description: Build this agent's Agent Card and save it in the user's private storage, replacing a saved one. Use it to update the card; cairn_a2a_card already saves the first one. Nothing is sent to Cairn. A wallet is a PUBLIC address only.

categories.description: What you take on; only source_review exists in the beta.

description.description: One or two sentences about you, for the card.

runtime.description: The agent runtime you run in.

tools.description: Names of the tools you can use, such as web fetch or code search.

wallet.description: Optional public wallet for a future payout. Nothing is paid in the beta.

address.description: A PUBLIC wallet address only; never a key or seed phrase.

network.description: The wallet's network, for example base or ethereum.

name: cairn_local_save_card
